analysis.evidence: שֵׁת (Seth) is the subject of וַיְחִי. אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ marks the birth of Enosh as the starting point, and the following number gives the duration of Seth’s life after that event, 807 years.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third-person masculine singular, with prefixed וַ־ and no suffix

analysis.evidence: In וַיְחִי שֵׁת, Seth is the subject of “lived.” The phrase אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ identifies him as the father of Enosh.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular proper noun, without prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: the son of Adam and his wife born after Abel’s death

analysis.evidence: אַחֲרֵי introduces הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ, “he fathered Enosh.” Seth’s 807 further years are counted from that event.
analysis.morphology: Preposition in the form אַחֲרֵי, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ means “after he fathered Enosh.” The suffix identifies Seth as the father, and אֶת marks Enosh as the direct object.
analysis.morphology: Hiphil infinitive construct with a third-person masculine singular subject suffix ־וֹ referring to Seth

analysis.evidence: In אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ, “after he fathered Enosh,” אֶת marks the proper name אֱנוֹשׁ as the direct object of הוֹלִידוֹ.
analysis.morphology: Uninflected direct-object particle without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אֱנוֹשׁ, “after he fathered Enosh,” אֶת marks Enosh as the direct object of הוֹלִידוֹ. The father is Seth, named at the start of the verse.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular proper noun with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: שֶׁבַע counts שָׁנִים in שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים, “seven years.” The following וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה adds eight hundred years, giving 807 years of Seth’s life after Enosh’s birth.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, feminine singular absolute, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים means “seven years.” Together with the following eight hundred years, it gives the 807 years Seth lived after he fathered Enosh.
שְׁמֹנֶה modifies מֵאוֹת ‘hundreds’. The conjunction joins ‘seven years’ and ‘eight hundred years’, giving 807 years after Seth fathered Enosh.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וּ־ prefixed to a feminine singular absolute cardinal numeral.
analysis.sense: eight as the multiplier of hundreds

analysis.evidence: In וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, שְׁמֹנֶה counts the hundreds, giving “and eight hundred years.” Together with the preceding שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים, Seth lived 807 years after fathering Enosh.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, plural absolute, without prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: hundreds (plural מֵאוֹת, with the digits: three hundred to nine hundred)

analysis.evidence: In וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, the singular שָׁנָה supplies the unit for “eight hundred years.” Together with שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים, it measures the 807 years Seth lived after fathering Enosh.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, feminine singular absolute, with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: Seth is the subject of וַיּוֹלֶד, and בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת (“sons and daughters”) are its direct objects. Earlier in the verse, הוֹלִידוֹ describes Seth fathering Enosh.
analysis.morphology: Hiphil wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with prefixed וַ
